name: Sight Unseen
description: Homicide detective Tess Avery is forced to quit the job she loves after nearly killing her partner and being diagnosed as clinically blind. Reluctant to accept help, Tess uses an assistance app and connects with Sunny Patel, a professional seeing-eye guide and agoraphobe living 3,000 miles away. Haunted by the unsolved cases she left behind, Tess uses a hidden camera and earpiece, while Sunny remotely steers Tess through life's obstacles -- and crimes -- as the two challenge preconceptions about ability, trust and where to draw the line.

videos.title: Tess
videos.overview: After losing her vision, detective Tess Avery is haunted by the case she left behind, until she meets an unusual seeing eye guide.

videos.title: Sunny
videos.overview: When a victim from one of Tess' unsolved cases wakes from a coma, her seeing eye guide Sunny Patel challenges Tess to get involved.

videos.title: Jake
videos.overview: Searching for her missing brother, Tess inserts herself into Jake's investigation to identify a dead John Doe but finds his killer instead.

videos.title: Mia
videos.overview: After turning down a token offer to come back to the force, Tess doubles down, secretly tackling a gruesome murder with Sunny's assistance.

videos.title: Matt
videos.overview: Tess works her first case as a police consultant with Sunny in her ear after one of Matt’s colleagues is found dead in the college pool.

videos.title: Lucas
videos.overview: Tess is quick to question Lucas' motive when he claims to need a place to crash in the middle of the night, only to later unearth a bombshell with Jake at a crime scene that suggests her brother may be implicated in the murder of a famous painter.

videos.title: Leo
videos.overview: Jake and Tess are investigating the shooting of a trucker when the Vice Squad shows up, demanding they cut their main suspect loose before they compromise one of Vice's investigations.

videos.title: Fluffed
videos.overview: Tess and Sunny explore themes of hidden identity as they investigate the murder of a realtor’s assistant in a glossy mansion he was preparing to sell, only to discover that neither the realtor nor the buyers he was prepping the mansion for are who they seem to be.

videos.title: Burn Notice
videos.overview: The sensational disappearance of two influencers who travel the country posting their van life adventures has Tess and Matt tracing their trail on an epic road trip – with Sunny riding shotgun through the car speakers.

videos.title: Razor's Edge
videos.overview: Tess and Sunny's relationship is put to the ultimate test when Tess reveals she knows who Sunny really is and why she needs to hide from the outside world. To prove Tess wrong, Sunny must face her deepest fear and relive the crime that sent her into hiding.

videos.title: Runaway Bride
videos.overview: Tess and Sunny track down the killer of an unknown bride found on a desolate beach, still in her wedding gown.

videos.title: About a Boy
videos.overview: A routine stop turns into a parent's worst nightmare when a 6-year-old boy is abducted during a carjacking. Tess and Jake race against time to rescue the child, tracking the kidnapper’s potential motivations.

videos.title: Chain Reaction
videos.overview: Tess and Leo find themselves trapped inside a chemical plant when an active shooter targets the facility's manager. While trying to evacuate workers, Tess must navigate the highly dangerous, flammable environment with Sunny's remote guidance.

videos.title: Murder on the Dancefloor
videos.overview: Tess and Sunny must unravel complicated family dynamics in what appears to be a chilling mother-daughter murder-suicide at a prestigious dance academy.

videos.title: Girls Like Us
videos.overview: Tensions run high as Tess and Sunny chase a killer on campus, while Matt makes a choice that compromises the investigation.

videos.title: Lost in Translation
videos.overview: A sleep-deprived Sunny has the day off, as Tess gets pulled into a 911 call with an injured man locked in a steel drum who has no idea who, or where, he is.

videos.title: Family Matters
videos.overview: Tess digs into the disappearance of a pastor's daughter, unraveling family secrets and prompting Sunny to reflect on her own family.

videos.title: Don't Look Back
videos.overview: The past comes back to haunt Tess, forcing her to put her career on the line as Sunny begins to face her own demons in therapy.

videos.title: Strangers in a Game
videos.overview: Tess and Sunny follow the tracks of a deadly weapon to find a new breed of criminal who seems to kill at random.

videos.title: Rekindling
videos.overview: Tess reunites with Jake on an undercover mission to dismantle a criminal network from within.
